summary: Fetch tag history in the release canary so readiness qualification can resolve the latest stable comparison base.
security: The canary remains pinned to the immutable triggering SHA; full history is read-only and used only to resolve the stable release baseline.
documentation: This release note records the canary checkout prerequisite; no operator procedure changes.
rollback: Revert the full-history checkout only if readiness receives an equally immutable explicit comparison ref.
validation: The canary workflow contract requires exact-SHA checkout together with full tag history.
A protected canary must complete the release-readiness drill before release resumes.
